description: Bars, clubs and rooms listed on JokeStack (Lokale on the Polish site) where comedy shows happen or could. Use it for 'where can I put on an open mic in Kraków?' or 'which bars host stand-up in Warsaw?'. Filters by size, own sound, bar, step-free entrance and the kinds of shows welcome. Returns each venue's name, address, size, upcoming events count, and link.

language.description: Language for names and links: 'pl' for jokestack.pl, 'en' for the English site. Defaults to the site that was called.

looking_for_events.description: Only venues that say they're looking for new events.

min_places.description: At least this many audience places, seated and standing together.

own_sound.description: Only venues with their own microphone and speakers.

place.description: A city or region, e.g. 'Kraków' or 'Małopolska'.

step_free.description: Only venues with a step-free entrance.

text.description: Words in the venue's name or address.

welcomes.description: Only venues that say this kind of show is welcome.

name: jokestack_search_venues
title: Search comedy venues
